test_statistics_endpoint: test the statistics endpoint returns num_examples, partial, and column statistics for a dataset
test_statistics_string_label_column: test the statistics endpoint returns string label column with frequencies and unique value counts
test_statistics_numeric_column: test the statistics endpoint returns int and float column statistics with histogram, mean, std, min, max
test_statistics_bool_column: test the statistics endpoint returns bool column statistics with nan counts and true false frequencies
test_statistics_list_column: test the statistics endpoint returns list column statistics with length histogram and nan proportions
